hero.title: Short-Term Car Rental in Warsaw
hero.description: Need a car for a few days, a weekend, or longer? Call or message us, and pick up your car in as little as 10 minutes - no unnecessary paperwork.

definition.title: What is short-term rental?
definition.text: Short-term rental means renting a car for anywhere from 24 hours to a month. It's ideal when you need a car right away - no long contracts, no online booking forms. With Vekaro, the whole process happens over a single phone call, and your car is ready to go.

whenToRent.title: When is short-term rental a good fit?
items: Business trips or meetings - when your own car isn't available or you're not based in Warsaw.
Weekend getaways - quick access to a car without using your own.
Replacement car - when your car is in for repairs and you still need to get around.
Last-minute needs - sometimes you just need a car right now, no planning ahead required.

whyVekaro.title: Why Vekaro?
items: No unnecessary paperwork - minimum formalities, maximum convenience.
Car in 10 minutes - from phone call to keys in hand.
Well-maintained vehicles - regularly serviced fleet in great condition.
Warsaw only - we know the city and we're always reachable.

howItWorks.title: How it works
steps: Call or message us on WhatsApp/Telegram.
Agree on dates and pick a car from our fleet.
Pick up your car - clean, fueled, and ready.

hero.title: Long-Term Car Rental in Warsaw
hero.description: Need a car for a month or longer? Call us and we will set up terms that fit your needs, no unnecessary paperwork, no down payment.

definition.title: What is long-term rental?
definition.text: Long-term rental means renting a car for one month or more. Unlike leasing, there is no down payment and no multi-year commitment. Price and terms are agreed individually, depending on the rental period and your needs. One call is enough, and we work out the rest together.

whyLongTerm.title: When does long-term rental make sense?
items: You are working or based in Warsaw for an extended period and buying a car isn't worth it.
You want to avoid service, insurance and tire costs, since we cover them.
You don't want to tie up your money in a car that loses value over time.
You want a predictable monthly cost instead of unplanned expenses.

whyVekaro.title: Why Vekaro?
items: No down payment, no unnecessary paperwork.
Terms and price agreed individually to fit your situation.
Well-maintained, regularly serviced cars.
Warsaw only, so we're always close by and quick to respond.

howItWorks.title: How it works
steps: Call or message us on WhatsApp/Telegram.
We discuss the rental period and set up terms that fit you.
Pick up your car and use it for the full rental period.

items.question: What's the minimum period for long-term rental?
items.answer: Long-term rental starts from one month.

items.question: Is the price fixed, or does it depend on the period?
items.answer: Price is agreed individually, based on rental length and your needs. Call us and we'll prepare an offer that fits.

items.question: Are service and insurance included?
items.answer: Yes, regular car maintenance is on us. We go over the details individually when you contact us.

items.question: Can I drive the rental car abroad?
items.answer: No, our cars can only be used within Poland.

hero.title: Car Rental for Companies and Insurance Providers
hero.description: Rent a car as a business, not as a private individual. We work with companies, insurance providers, and business owners who need an extra vehicle.

definition.title: What is business car rental?
definition.text: It's the same offer as our short-term and long-term rental, with one difference. The car is rented to a company, not a private person. This works for business owners, insurance providers, and other rental companies that need an extra vehicle for their own fleet. Terms are agreed individually, in a conversation with our representative.

whoItsFor.title: Who is this for?
items: Insurance providers who need a replacement car for their clients while a vehicle is being repaired.
Rental companies and other businesses that need an extra vehicle for their fleet.
Business owners who want to rent a car under their company instead of privately.

whyVekaro.title: Why Vekaro?
items: Simple terms, agreed individually with our representative.
Well-maintained, regularly serviced cars.
Quick phone contact, no unnecessary paperwork upfront.
Warsaw only, so we're always close by and quick to respond.

howItWorks.title: How does the cooperation work?
steps: Call or message us on WhatsApp/Telegram and describe your needs.
Our representative will go over the terms and contract details in a meeting.
Pick up the car and use it under the agreed terms.

items.question: Which companies can use this offer?
items.answer: We work with insurance providers, other rental companies, and business owners who want to rent a car under their company.

items.question: Do you offer replacement cars for insurance providers?
items.answer: Yes, that's one of the main areas of our cooperation with insurance companies.

items.question: How does the contract process work?
items.answer: Terms and details are agreed individually in a meeting with our representative. Call us to set it up.

items.question: Can I rent more than one car?
items.answer: Yes, we handle both single orders and larger fleets. Contact us to discuss the details.

promo.title: Need a car today?
promo.subtitle: Call now, get it in 10 minutes

about.title: About the Company
about.paragraph: Vekaro has been renting cars in Warsaw for more than 7 years. Our team is small, but always reachable. We don't promise round the clock support, but when something unusual comes up, we look for a solution instead of turning a client away. We run our own car service with experienced mechanics, keeping our fleet in great technical condition.

fleet.sectionSubtitle: Choose the car that fits your needs and requirements.

items.question: Can I drive the rental car abroad?
items.answer: No, our cars can only be used within Poland.

items.question: How do I book a car?
items.answer: Just call or message us on WhatsApp/Telegram - there's no online booking.

items.question: What cars are available?
items.answer: Currently Fiat Tipo and Skoda Citigo, with more models being added.
